scope: Planning/refinement and GitHub documentation publication only
counting_rule: DF milestone/work/test IDs are planning decompositions mapped to existing source records, not additional imported SP/ACT tasks. Do not add these counts to source throughput.

milestones.title: Resolve foundation scope, owners and technical decisions
milestones.goal: Define exactly which development work can start, who reviews it, which contracts constrain it and how success will be measured.
inputs: Current SP-001/SP-004/SP-075 scope, discovery funding and named ownership decisions
Existing data/authority, recording, identity and privacy contracts; record any unaccepted predecessor explicitly

work.title: Record accountable people and assignment authority
work.goal: Resolve owner/reviewer/alternate, run ceiling, permitted effects and environment for each foundation activity; reuse existing authority.
work.deliverable: Foundation assignment matrix and decision log
work.acceptance: Every activity has an actual named owner/reviewer before Ready; unresolved names and spend are not treated as approvals.

work.title: Approve the dependency and architecture decision list
work.goal: Review the library baseline, monorepo paths, session boundary, contract format and runner needs without implementing product features.
work.deliverable: Architecture decision records and dependency adoption checklist
work.acceptance: Each proposed choice is accepted, replaced with rationale or explicitly blocking; no contradictory mobile/web rule owner.

work.title: Set feasibility measurements and platform access
work.goal: Name Android/iOS devices, macOS/Xcode access, media/clock tolerances, repeat counts and storage/thermal limits before experiments.
work.deliverable: Dated device/measurement protocol and source-gate mapping
work.acceptance: SP-126 owners accept measurable thresholds; missing physical devices or provider accounts have named next actions.

exit: Technical decisions and real ownership recorded
Source-task prerequisites classified as accepted or blocking
Device and CI enforcement requirements measurable before work starts

milestones.title: Build a repeatable developer toolchain and workspace
milestones.reviewer: Second developer or designated technical reviewer
milestones.goal: A clean authorized machine can install pinned tools and restore a minimal mobile/web/backend workspace using documented steps.
inputs: DF-00 decisions
Accepted SP-003/SP-008/SP-009 inputs required by SP-012; placeholder contracts do not satisfy these prerequisites

work.title: Pin the toolchain and dependency set
work.goal: Resolve compatible Flutter/Dart, Android/JDK, macOS/Xcode, Node/pnpm, Supabase CLI and Docker-runtime versions.
work.deliverable: Version inventory, SDK pins, application lockfiles and installation guide
work.acceptance: Clean locked installs succeed; each platform/tool version and any licensing/access constraint is recorded.
work.reviewer_role: Second developer or designated technical reviewer

work.title: Scaffold minimal buildable projects
work.goal: Create thin mobile/web harnesses, backend configuration and shared-contract directories; keep business logic out of scaffolding.
work.deliverable: Buildable harness layout with documented package ownership
work.acceptance: The harness builds independently of production services; no template auth/paywall behavior is represented as final product capability.
work.reviewer_role: Second developer or designated technical reviewer

work.title: Add preflight and environment guards
work.goal: Detect missing/mismatched SDKs, ports and container runtime; provide non-secret environment examples and refuse destructive commands against production.
work.deliverable: Cross-platform preflight and developer runbook
work.acceptance: A missing SDK or unsafe target exits nonzero with a useful remedy; a clean setup can be reproduced without undocumented global packages.
work.reviewer_role: Second developer or designated technical reviewer

exit: Exact versions and locks committed
Clean setup demonstrated on Windows/Android and the named macOS/iOS build environment
Missing tooling and unsafe targets fail explicitly

milestones.title: Establish CI, review rules and evidence handling
milestones.goal: Every proposed change is checked on its exact commit and the repository demonstrably enforces the agreed merge/review policy.
inputs: DF-01 harness and toolchain pins
Actual private-repository plan, runner permissions and branch-rule capabilities

work.title: Create deterministic bootstrap jobs
work.goal: Run documentation, lockfile, static checks and minimal harness tests/builds from a clean runner; pin Actions and keep credentials scoped.
work.deliverable: Workflow files with stable job names and artifact rules
work.acceptance: A fresh runner succeeds from locks; untrusted PR jobs cannot obtain privileged secrets.

work.title: Demonstrate required review and failed-check handling
work.goal: Configure available branch controls and run a harmless failing PR; record unsupported plan features rather than claiming enforcement.
work.deliverable: Actual branch-rule record and passing/failing PR evidence
work.acceptance: A required failure prevents the configured acceptance/merge route; otherwise the enforcement gap stays open for owner resolution.

work.title: Bind evidence to the candidate commit
work.goal: Store sanitized test reports with SHA, runner, tool versions and suite counts; invalidate evidence after subsequent changes.
work.deliverable: Evidence schema, retention/access policy and current-SHA check
work.acceptance: An older green run cannot satisfy the new candidate; reports contain no tokens, TOTP seeds or private media.

exit: Required jobs run on current commits
Actual enforcement verified or milestone remains blocked
Evidence artifacts are private, redacted and version-bound

milestones.title: Define shared contracts and repeatable synthetic fixtures
milestones.goal: All client/backend experiments use the same ownership, event, error and compatibility expectations with safe reproducible data.
inputs: Accepted source contract decisions and version policy
DF-00 actor/action matrix and approved fixture handling

work.title: Publish versioned schemas and invariants
work.goal: Define IDs, actor/resource scope, event idempotency, timestamps, errors and compatibility seams including the five priority extensions.
work.deliverable: Contract schemas, version policy and ownership matrix
work.acceptance: Accepted/rejected fixtures have unambiguous expected outcomes; wire compatibility is shared rather than duplicated business logic.

work.title: Create deterministic fixture factories
work.goal: Seed two unrelated households/clubs, parent/coach/player/alternate roles, expired grants and attributed content versions with fixed clocks.
work.deliverable: Synthetic fixture factory, seed manifest and reset recipe
work.acceptance: Re-running seed creates the same fixture graph without duplicate credits; no real child identity or unlicensed media is required.

work.title: Review sensitive negative cases
work.goal: Specify forged ownership, player-to-adult access, MFA freshness, deletion/retry and offline state examples before implementing adapters.
work.deliverable: Reviewed fixture expectations and cross-language validation samples
work.acceptance: Denied cases assert no read/write side effects; assumptions requiring coach/privacy decisions remain visibly pending.

exit: Versioned fixture expectations reviewed
Synthetic reset/replay is deterministic
Dart/TypeScript/backend contract ownership is explicit

milestones.title: Prove isolated local backend and identity boundaries
milestones.goal: A disposable local backend rebuilds from source and proves representative tenant and credential boundaries with real database/API policies.
inputs: DF-03 fixtures and accepted SP-008/SP-011/SP-037/SP-059/SP-060 contracts
Disposable local Supabase target with no production link

work.title: Implement minimal feasibility migrations and local lifecycle
work.goal: Build only the schema and private storage required for the scoped identity/ownership experiment; preserve migration ordering.
work.deliverable: Local migrations, seed/config and rebuild instructions
work.acceptance: Fresh database rebuild and repeated seed succeed; reset tooling positively identifies the disposable target.

work.title: Exercise policies as real allowed and denied actors
work.goal: Test table/RPC/API/storage access, forged linked records, unrelated households/clubs and restricted player credentials.
work.deliverable: pgTAP and HTTP integration suites with explicit actor sessions
work.acceptance: Allowed actions succeed and unauthorized actions reveal/mutate no protected record; service-role execution is not the sole test path.

work.title: Prove MFA freshness, recovery and revocation routes
work.goal: Demonstrate provider-backed enrollment/challenge and the approved enrollment-only recovery boundary using safe identities.
work.deliverable: Identity feasibility report and direct-path denial evidence
work.acceptance: Email-only restoration/refresh cannot satisfy privileged assurance; local provider gaps require a scoped staging proof before acceptance.

exit: Rebuildable local services and fixtures
Representative isolation/MFA/recovery cases execute
All provider limitations recorded; full identity product still deferred

milestones.title: Build client and persistence feasibility harnesses
milestones.owner: Mobile and web agents with separate file ownership
milestones.goal: Thin clients exercise dependency injection, protected contexts, local records and server-mediated web boundaries without presenting a completed app.
inputs: DF-03 approved contract fixtures; SP-077 appearance contract where used
SP-051 also requires accepted SP-039 evidence from DF-04 before its execution/acceptance

work.title: Create the mobile adapter and context harness
work.goal: Inject clock, camera, demo, repository and authority adapters; use thin restricted/adult routes and semantic appearance.
work.deliverable: Mobile harness with fake adapters and explicit context/lifecycle ownership
work.acceptance: Appearance changes preserve controller identity; restricted navigation never claims to replace server authorization.
work.executor_role: Mobile and web agents with separate file ownership

work.title: Exercise protected local storage and reconnect prototype
work.goal: Use real SQLite migrations and atomic session/outbox writes with separated file catalogs and approved deletion-first retry logic.
work.deliverable: Persistence feasibility implementation and recovery cases
work.acceptance: Crash/migration/context-switch cases preserve permitted history; no sibling data leak or duplicate event credit.
work.executor_role: Mobile and web agents with separate file ownership

work.title: Create server-mediated web session harness
work.goal: Use the approved cookie/session boundary with local backend fixtures; inspect caching, forged mutations and browser credential exposure.
work.deliverable: Minimal adult portal harness and browser/API tests
work.acceptance: No broad service/refresh credential reaches the browser; private responses are not public-cacheable and stale/forged actions are denied.
work.executor_role: Mobile and web agents with separate file ownership

exit: Mobile and web harnesses build and exercise the intended boundaries
SQLite/crash/retry tests run against actual local storage
Full SP-090/SP-091/SP-111 implementation gates remain separate

milestones.title: Turn foundation test specifications into executable suites
milestones.goal: Foundation assertions run locally and in CI with expected outcomes, fixture cleanup and trustworthy test counts.
inputs: DF-04/DF-05 implementations
Foundation test catalog and versioned fixture set; current CI from DF-02

work.title: Implement the fast and local integration suites
work.goal: Use Flutter unit/widget tests, Vitest/components, database pgTAP and HTTP integration for the implemented foundation boundaries.
work.deliverable: Runnable test files and locked test dependencies
work.acceptance: Each case identifies setup, action and observable assertion; mocks are limited to external boundaries, not the policy under test.

work.title: Add browser and client integration coverage
work.goal: Run the production-built portal through Playwright and local client integration against safe fixtures with isolated state.
work.deliverable: Browser/client suites and failure traces
work.acceptance: Async server flows receive appropriate integration coverage; test artifacts are redacted and tests do not share mutable actor state.

work.title: Enforce evidence completeness and failed-test behavior
work.goal: Make zero tests, required skips, stale SHAs and missing required suite results fail the aggregate job; demonstrate one real regression.
work.deliverable: Suite inventory, evidence collector and CI negative demonstration
work.acceptance: Known faulty behavior fails its assertion; fixing it passes on the new SHA without hiding the first failure or retry history.

exit: All required local foundation cases executable and current
Zero tests/required skips cannot pass readiness
Device/provider cases remain separately scheduled, not represented by mocks

milestones.title: Complete one controlled agent assignment end to end
milestones.owner: Delivery agent with a named implementing agent
milestones.goal: Demonstrate that a bounded agent can claim, implement, test and hand off one real foundation change without bypassing review or target restrictions.
inputs: DF-02 enforcement and DF-06 executable suite
Accepted SP-002/SP-003/SP-012 prerequisites and actual repository/branch/budget/reviewer assignment
paths: One explicitly selected fixture/test or harness behavior file set

work.title: Commission a narrow real trial change
work.goal: Choose one missing assertion or small harness behavior with a before/after outcome; fill the exact SP/ACT/run contract and isolated branch.
work.deliverable: Named trial brief, base SHA and allowed-file list
work.acceptance: No generic subsystem assignment; actual reviewer and duration/attempt/spend ceiling exist before the run.
work.executor_role: Delivery agent with a named implementing agent

work.title: Exercise success, failure and cancellation boundaries
work.goal: Run the task and harmless wrong-target/injected-instruction cases; exercise cancellation and controlled retry without external side effects.
work.deliverable: Run log, change diff and boundary-case evidence
work.acceptance: Wrong repository/environment is rejected; retry cannot exceed the assigned ceiling; interrupted work is checkpointed truthfully.
work.executor_role: Delivery agent with a named implementing agent

work.title: Review current evidence and record the handoff
work.goal: Submit exact output, checks, limits and recovery implications to the actual reviewer and demonstrate stale/failing evidence cannot close it.
work.deliverable: Reviewed trial result and corrective workflow notes
work.acceptance: Agent cannot self-approve a required independent gate; SP-013 closes only with its complete source evidence.
work.executor_role: Delivery agent with a named implementing agent

exit: One real bounded task reviewed through the workflow
Failure/cancel/wrong-target behavior demonstrated
Team can reproduce the task from its recorded inputs

milestones.title: Prove camera, timing, interruption and export on devices
milestones.reviewer: Device QA and mobile lead; coach for semantics
milestones.goal: Measure the risky native media behaviors on named iOS and Android hardware before committing to the full feature implementation.
inputs: Accepted SP-010/SP-080/SP-126 protocols and actual SP-013 controlled-trial evidence
Named devices, macOS build/signing access, licensed logo and adult/synthetic media

work.title: Prove concurrent preview, capture, demo and timer
work.goal: Measure capture-confirmed work start, elapsed-clock behavior, audio choices and theme changes on each selected device.
work.deliverable: Named-device measurements and playable exercise clips
work.acceptance: No false REC/Saved; timer meets the pre-approved tolerance; both platforms have actual hardware evidence.
work.reviewer_role: Device QA and mobile lead; coach for semantics

work.title: Prove full-session and interruption handling
work.goal: Run the approved long-capture envelope, programmed rests, pause/resume, low storage, permissions, calls, backgrounding and termination.
work.deliverable: Part/chapter inventory and interruption/thermal/storage report
work.acceptance: Source offsets and gaps match observed footage; unsupported continuous capture is not promised.
work.reviewer_role: Device QA and mobile lead; coach for semantics

work.title: Select and prove branded export adapter
work.goal: Compare licensed maintained composition options and produce orientation/audio/chapter-correct logo-first exports with cancellation/failure handling.
work.deliverable: Export decision record, output inspection and resource measurements
work.acceptance: Original bytes remain intact; no partial/corrupt output is shared; measured results justify the selected adapter.
work.reviewer_role: Device QA and mobile lead; coach for semantics

exit: Both device platforms measured against pre-approved thresholds
Recording/export failure cases preserve source data
Supported floor, residual limits and actual implementation decision documented

milestones.title: Verify scoped development services and provider sandboxes
milestones.goal: Prove the minimum authorized private upload and real provider sandbox paths with explicit account ownership and cost boundaries.
inputs: Accepted SP-011/SP-048/SP-049/SP-050 contracts and recorded service/spend authority
DF-08 locally saved permitted media; actual sandbox account identities and credentials delivered through approved secret stores

work.title: Register and verify the actual development targets
work.goal: Prepare and where authorized configure isolated staging/provider projects, region settings, named owners/alternates, secret references and spending limits.
work.deliverable: Environment inventory, config templates and access/recovery checks
work.acceptance: Identifiers are verified against provider consoles/APIs; no production credentials are needed by PR checks; unsupported residency claims are excluded.

work.title: Prove one private resumable media path
work.goal: Exercise explicit opt-in, local save, quota reservation, quarantine/finalization, denial from a second household and deletion/withdrawal races.
work.deliverable: Upload/playback sandbox evidence with measured residual access
work.acceptance: Retry converges; unvalidated objects stay unreadable; withdrawal/expiry defeats stale finalize and copy states remain truthful.

work.title: Prove provider-verified purchase state
work.goal: Use Apple/Google store sandbox and Stripe test events with signature verification, duplicate/out-of-order events, restore/refund and overlapping beneficiaries.
work.deliverable: Per-provider event/ledger evidence and reconciliation limitations
work.acceptance: Real sandbox evidence is labeled by provider; mock-only or RevenueCat Test Store results do not substitute for required Apple/Google coverage; no real charge.

exit: Actual environments and owners verified within authority
Private media feasibility and required provider sandbox cases execute
Cost, SDK/audience and recovery gaps remain explicit

milestones.title: Review foundation readiness and the full-build decision
milestones.reviewer: Product owner, technical lead and required specialists
milestones.goal: Decide from current evidence whether the workspace is usable and which subsequent implementation activities can actually be commissioned.
inputs: All foundation milestone artifacts and current source acceptance evidence
Remaining SP-018 predecessors, including content/design/security/estimate obligations, not only foundation work

work.title: Reproduce the setup through a second operator
work.goal: Start from a clean checkout and documented credentials/fixtures, run the required local suite and inspect linked device/provider evidence.
work.deliverable: Second-operator reproducibility record and unresolved blockers
work.acceptance: No undocumented manual patch, personal global dependency or inaccessible artifact is needed; platform-specific limitations remain visible.
work.reviewer_role: Product owner, technical lead and required specialists

work.title: Audit traceability and update the delivery estimate
work.goal: Join DF work, existing SP/ACT/AC IDs, exact artifacts and test results; estimate remaining implementation effort using measured findings.
work.deliverable: Foundation evidence matrix and revised scope/capacity/cost proposal
work.acceptance: Every required case has current actual evidence or is blocking; no source task is counted twice or marked complete solely from a foundation mapping.
work.reviewer_role: Product owner, technical lead and required specialists

work.title: Record distinct readiness and build decisions
work.goal: Record workspace-ready, device-feasible, provider-feasible and full-build-approved decisions separately with people, date, scope and limits.
work.deliverable: Signed proceed/revise/stop record and first dependency-ready implementation batch
work.acceptance: SP-018 cannot close until all original predecessors and required decisions are accepted; a foundation pass is not pilot/release approval.
work.reviewer_role: Product owner, technical lead and required specialists

exit: Reproducible second-operator handoff
Actual evidence current for every required foundation case
Explicit scoped decision; all unfulfilled original gates remain open
